title: engineering-tables: steam tables (IAPWS-IF97), t and chi-square distributions, normal CDF and unit conversion in JavaScript
description:
Zero-dependency JavaScript library for engineering reference values: saturated water and steam properties from IAPWS-IF97 regions 1, 2 and 4, Student's t and chi-square CDFs and critical values, the standard normal CDF, and unit conversion for pressure, energy, power, force and torque.

The test suite checks every function against published reference values, including the verification tables in the IAPWS-IF97 release, which the implementation reproduces to 8 significant figures.

Also on npm as engineering-tables. The tables it computes are published as a dataset, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23936027. Author: David Mashiah.
